about: The six readers of the site (the author, 2026-10-16: the front page offers a door per reader, and each door is an umbrella page that reads the whole site from that reader's place). Built on the offer page's seven doors (the 2022 audience list) and on the journeys of data/journeys.json, which the umbrellas absorb: a journey's steps are written once, there.
